title: Pot Hole - Hazardous
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a hazardous pot hole located in the alley or street. A location is considered a hazard if it has the potential to cause serious damage to vehicles or pedestrians. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 12 hours.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a hazardous pothole in a street or alley.
actions.why: For a pothole in a street or alley that could cause serious damage to a vehicle or injury to a pedestrian. This request must be dispatched, and its description and instructions direct people to call 311.
